work.note: Goldilocks and the Three Bears é um conto de fadas inglês, registrado por escrito pelo poeta Robert Southey em 1837. facts.label: Revisão: comparar
facts.sub: Use -er than para duas coisas e the -est para a primeira entre várias: The scone is bigger. The cookie is the cheapest.

facts.label: Comparativo
facts.sub: Para comparar duas coisas, use -er than com adjetivos curtos: The scone is bigger than the muffin. The muffin is sweeter. Com adjetivos longos, use more: The cream is more expensive.

facts.label: Superlativo
facts.sub: Para dizer qual é o primeiro de três ou mais, use the -est: The cookie is the sweetest. The muffin is the smallest. Com adjetivos longos, use the most: the most famous.

pages.title: A busy cafe · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Wednesday morning in a busy cafe in Belfast. The smell of fresh bread fills the air. Rhea stands at the counter with Sara. A waiter puts a big menu in front of them. There are many cakes in the window. They need to choose.
“Sara, look at the menu. Which one is the best?” says Rhea. “The scone is bigger than the muffin.” says Sara. “But the muffin is sweeter. The cookie is the sweetest.” says Rhea.
